title: Best Free OpenRouter AI Models for Programming

facts.fact: The page reports a benchmark of all 22 active free OpenRouter models (endpoint IDs ending in :free), using N=100 availability probes and 25 deterministic coding challenges.
facts.quote: Empirical benchmark of all 22 active free models on OpenRouter (:free) across N=100 availability telemetry probes and 25 deterministic coding challenges.

facts.fact: The page states the coding suite contains 25 deterministic programming challenges.
The availability probe consists of N=100 pings per model.
facts.quote: Availability Probe N=100 Pings 24h Diurnal Sampling

facts.fact: The page says the models were last tested on 2026-09-19.
The page states the data was observed on 19 September 2026, the planned weekly refresh is overdue, and no newer successful run is documented.
facts.quote: Data was observed on 19 September 2026. The planned weekly refresh is overdue and no newer successful run is documented here.

facts.fact: The page lists a previously planned retest date of 2026-09-26 and states that no verified rerun exists.
The page defines the 'Sweet Spot' quadrant as models with at least 80% availability and at least 18 tasks passed.
The page labels 8 models as 'The Usable Sweet Spot'.
In the page's table, LiquidAI LFM2.5-2.6B reported 100% availability (100/100), median latency 0.62s, 11/25 tasks passed (44.0%), and a burst limit of 20 requests.
In the page's table, NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Ultra reported 48% availability (48/100), median latency 4.6s, 24/25 tasks passed (96.0%), and a burst limit of 4 requests.
In the page's table, NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Content Safety reported 2/25 tasks passed (8.0%), 60% availability (60/100), and median latency 0.9s.
In the page's table, DeepSeek V4 Flash 0731 reported 84% availability (84/100), median latency 1.84s, 23/25 tasks passed (92.0%), and a burst limit of 11 requests.
In the page's table, Cohere North Mini Code reported 96% availability (96/100), median latency 0.88s, 21/25 tasks passed (84.0%), and a burst limit of 18 requests.
In the page's table, Qwen 3.8 27B reported 92% availability (92/100), median latency 1.42s, 22/25 tasks passed (88.0%), and a burst limit of 14 requests.
In the page's table, NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Super reported 68% availability (68/100), median latency 2.85s, 22/25 tasks passed (88.0%), and a burst limit of 7 requests.
The page lists a 1,024k context window for DeepSeek V4 Flash 0731 in its results table.
